हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: In the affluent Shekhawat family, patriarch Rajveer's shocking decision to name his illegitimate son Kabir as heir instead of his legitimate son Aryan triggers a devastating chain of events. Aryan's jealousy drives him to orchestrate failed murder attempts on Kabir, manipulate and ultimately cause the death of his pregnant girlfriend Meera, and eventually murder his own father with a lethal injection. As the family unravels, a hidden diary reveals the ultimate truth - Kabir is actually Gayatri's biological son from a rape by Rajveer's deceased brother, making him the true Shekhawat heir. The revelation culminates in Gayatri shooting Aryan to protect Kabir, leaving the family destroyed but the truth finally exposed.
